Title: Angular Cheilitis: If You're Licking Your Cracked Lip Corners, Stop

Description:
If the corners of your mouth keep cracking, it's rarely just dry skin. Saliva pooling in the corners, a diet low in B vitamins, and fatigue with a weakened immune system are the three habits behind most flare-ups. Skip the licking and seal the area with petroleum jelly, add eggs, dairy, and leafy greens for B2, and prioritize consistent sleep so your skin can actually repair itself.
